Fa sonar les fills una darrere l'altra (: Plays the children one after another (can loop and shuffle). GO moves to the cue after the group.
El GO dispara la primera fill i deixa en: GO fires the first child and puts the second in standby: each following GO fires the next child. Useful to organise the list in sections.

Cada GO dispara una fill a l'atzar, sens: Each GO fires a random child, without repeating until all have played. GO moves to the cue after the group.
Totes les fills comencen alhora; la pre-: All children start at once; each child's pre-wait is its time within the group. GO moves to the cue after the group.
